pokedexEntries.go: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

pokedexEntries.si: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

pokedexEntries.cr: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.

pokedexEntries.rs: AIPOM’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the POKéMON uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

pokedexEntries.em: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM’s real hands have become rather clumsy.

pokedexEntries.di: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

pokedexEntries.prl: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won’t fall off while asleep.

pokedexEntries.pt: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
